copy.heading: Let's Connect!
copy.intro: Feel free to reach out with your projects, questions, or to connect. I'll respond promptly, and we can explore opportunities together.

responsive.desktop: At 1200px and wider, the form occupies 60% on the left and contact details occupy the remaining space on the right.
responsive.tablet: From 810px through 1199px, contact and social details form two columns above the full-width form.
responsive.mobile: Below 810px, contact details, social details, and the form stack in one column; name and email also stack.
